name: orca
description: Requires the Orca app. Adds a GitHub-Issues backlog and planning layer on top of Orca's own worktree/terminal CLI: migrate a repo's tracking onto the model, plan work adversarially, hand it off to a worktree agent, watch lane state, and gate finished branches against the issue's own acceptance checklist. Orca's bundled skills (orca-cli, orchestration) own the CLI itself — these skills point at them rather than restating them.
